title: Thermochemistry of Tetrazete and Tetraazatetrahedrane: A High-Level Computational Study

bond_params.description: Rectangular D2h ring ('tetrazete'), alternating short (1.287, N=N-like) and long (1.542, N-N single-like) bonds, read directly off Figure 2 image.

bond_params.description: Open-chain Cs triplet N4: two terminal N-N bonds ~1.168 A each (similar to N2 bond), one central N-N bond 1.465 A (elongated single bond vs hydrazine reference 1.438 A). Only ONE of the chain's two internal angles is given explicitly in Figure 2 (117.4 deg / 114.0 deg CISD); the second angle is not stated in text or legible in the figure -- do not assume symmetry, flag as missing for the build phase.

species.notes: LIKELY THE SAME SPECIES as N4b.pdf's structure '4, Cs (3A'')' (Bittererova et al. 2000) -- cross-check both extractions; this one (Glukhovtsev/Laiter 1996) is missing one chain angle that N4b.pdf's extraction may supply, so the two together may give a complete geometry.
